sentences.text: We baited their whole platoon into the quarry, then Priya's medium clipped the artillery sitting naked at spawn. Reset to the rail yard, both of you — I can hear their tracks squealing on cobblestone from here. Down to two hundred hitpoints, tracks blown, he still reversed onto the cap circle and won us the match. Swap the vents for optics on open maps; view range wins more games than a two-percent gun handling buff. He bagged the oranda one-handed, puffed the bag with pure oxygen, and spun it shut like he'd done it ten thousand times. The ammonia strip turned dark green before she'd even finished dipping it, and the customer's face fell. We keep the feeder goldfish by the register; impulse math says a dollar fish sells itself. Her manager insisted the pothos cuttings drooping into the goldfish aquarium were filtration, not decoration. Nitrite at two parts per million explains the gasping; do a fifty percent water change tonight and retest tomorrow. Someone returned a heater claiming it boiled their shrimp, receipt stapled to a damp paper towel. Nobody warned the new hire that the snails in the plant bins multiply faster than she can scoop them out. Did anybody restock the frozen bloodworms, or are we telling customers Tuesday again? Some kid pressed his whole face against the angelfish display and left a perfect nose print for me to wipe off. You'll find the airline tubing on aisle three, right between the check valves and the bags of crushed coral. "Twist the bag three times, flip the corners, band it tight — nobody wants a leaker on the drive home." Do the neon tetras come with any guarantee if they die within a week? Thursday's discus shipment means draining and scrubbing the whole quarantine system after close. "What's eating holes in these sword plants?" she asked, holding up a leaf like evidence. Betta cups again, stacked crooked on the endcap, half of them gone cloudy overnight. Customers requesting a water analysis must bring at least four ounces of sample in a clean, soap-free container. What is the meaning of the word tank?
